title: 第 1 回（辦公室・零售・旅遊）

p1.img: A woman in an office is typing on a laptop at a desk near a window, with a coffee mug beside her.
p1.why: 照片裡有咖啡杯和窗戶，但她的動作是打字。(A)(C)(D) 都是提到照片裡的東西、動作卻錯。

p1.img: Several chairs are stacked against the wall of an empty conference room.
o: Chairs have been stacked against a wall.
A man is moving a table.
Some people are sitting in a meeting.
p1.why: 沒人的照片常用「have been + p.p.」描述物品狀態。(D) being cleaned 需要有人正在打掃。

p1.img: A man wearing a helmet is climbing a ladder next to a building.
p1.why: 直接看主要動作：爬梯子。

p1.img: Fruit and vegetables are displayed in baskets outside a small grocery store.
o: Produce is being loaded onto a truck.
Some produce is on display outside a shop.
A customer is paying at the counter.
p1.zh: 一些蔬果陳列在商店外面。
p1.why: produce＝農產品。(B) 沒有卡車，(D) 籃子是滿的。

p1.img: Two people are shaking hands across a table in a bright office.
o: They're walking out of a room.
p1.why: (B) 交換名片是常見陷阱，但照片是握手。

p1.img: A passenger is pulling a suitcase through an airport terminal.
o: A passenger is boarding a plane.
Some luggage is on a cart.
A woman is pulling a suitcase.
p1.zh: 一位女士正拉著行李箱。
p1.why: (A) 行李箱沒打開；(B) 還沒上飛機。

p2a.q: Where is the staff meeting being held?
Who's ordering the office supplies this month?
p2a.zh: 這個月誰負責訂辦公用品？
p2a.why: Who 問人；(B) 是用品內容。

p2a.q: When does the flight to Singapore leave?
p2a.zh: 飛新加坡的班機幾點起飛？
p2a.why: When 問時間；(C) 是飛行多久。

p2a.q: Why is the store closing early today?
p2a.why: Why → Because。(B) close 同字陷阱。

p2a.q: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?
How long will the repairs take?
Have you sent the invoice to the client?
p2a.zh: 你把發票寄給客戶了嗎？

p2a.q: The printer on this floor isn't working.
o: Try the one in the lobby.
p2a.why: 直述句 → 提出解決辦法。

p2a.q: Could you help me set up the projector?
p2a.why: 請求 → 答應。(B) project 發音陷阱。

p2a.q: What did you think of the new hotel?
o: I think it's on Fifth Avenue.
p2a.why: What do you think of → 意見。

p2a.q: Isn't the sale ending this weekend?
o: At the end of the hall.
No, it was extended until next Friday.
p2a.zh: 特價不是這週末結束嗎？
p2a.why: 否定問句照一般問句答。

p2a.q: Who should I call about the broken air conditioner?
Why don't we take a taxi to the convention center?
o: Good idea, it's starting to rain.
p2a.zh: 我們何不搭計程車去會展中心？

p2b.q: Where can I find the employee handbook?
When will the new menu be available?
How much is the shipping fee?
o: It's free for orders over 50 dollars.

p2b.q: Do you want to meet in the morning or after lunch?
p2b.zh: 你想早上見還是午餐後？

p2b.q: The client's flight has been delayed.
o: Then let's push the meeting back.
p2b.why: 直述句 → 自然反應：延後會議。

p2b.q: What time does the pharmacy open?
Would you mind checking these figures?
p2b.zh: 你介意幫我核對這些數字嗎？
p2b.why: Would you mind → Not at all＝不介意（答應）。

o: Deliver it to the front desk.

p2b.q: Are there any tickets left for tonight's show?
o: Only a few in the back row.

p2b.q: How often is the lobby cleaned?
I can't log in to my e-mail account.
p2b.zh: 我登不進電子郵件帳號。

script.t: Hi, I'm calling about the conference room I booked for Thursday afternoon.
Yes, Ms. Park. You reserved the Garden Room from one to four, right?
That's right. But we now have twenty people attending instead of twelve. Will the room be big enough?
I'm afraid not. The Garden Room only seats fifteen. The Lakeview Room holds thirty, and it's available that day.
Great. Is there a price difference?
It's fifty dollars more. I can switch the booking now and e-mail you the new confirmation.

p3a.zh: 女子打電話說週四下午訂的會議室人數從 12 人增為 20 人；男子說花園廳只坐 15 人，建議改湖景廳（可坐 30 人，多 50 美元），並會寄新的確認信。

qs.q: Why is the woman calling?
o: To ask about a larger room
To order lunch for a meeting
qs.why: 人數增加，問房間夠不夠大。

qs.q: How many people does the Garden Room hold?
What will the man most likely do next?

script.t: Excuse me, I bought this jacket here last week, but the zipper broke after two days.
I'm sorry about that. Do you have your receipt?
Yes, here it is. I'd prefer an exchange rather than a refund. I really like the style.
Let me check. Hmm, we don't have your size in black, but we have it in navy blue.
Navy is fine. Could I try it on first?
Of course. The fitting rooms are next to the shoe section.

p3a.zh: 男子上週買的外套拉鍊壞了，想換貨不退款；店員說黑色沒他的尺寸，有深藍色；男子想先試穿。

qs.q: What problem does the man mention?
o: A jacket is the wrong size.

qs.q: What does the man want to do?
Where are the fitting rooms?

script.t: Tom, have you finished the sales report for the regional managers?
Almost. I'm still waiting for the figures from the Denver office.
The meeting's at ten tomorrow. Do you think you'll have it by then?
I should. Denver said they'd send the numbers this afternoon.
OK. Once it's done, could you print twelve copies and put them in the boardroom?
Sure, I'll do that first thing in the morning.

p3a.zh: 女子問銷售報告完成沒；男子在等丹佛辦公室的數字，對方說下午會寄；女子請他完成後印 12 份放在董事會議室。

qs.q: What is the man waiting for?
When is the meeting?
What does the woman ask the man to do?

script.t: Welcome to Harbor View Hotel. How can I help you?
I'm checking in. The reservation is under Lopez.
Yes, two nights in a king room. Breakfast is included and served from six thirty to ten.
Perfect. Is there a shuttle to the airport? My flight leaves early on Friday.
There is. It runs every thirty minutes starting at five A.M. You can sign up at the front desk the night before.

p3a.zh: 女子辦理入住（兩晚、含早餐 6:30–10:00），問有沒有機場接駁；男子說早上五點起每 30 分鐘一班，前一晚在櫃台登記。

qs.q: Where does the conversation take place?
What is included with the room?
What does the man say the woman should do?
o: Sign up for the shuttle in advance

script.t: I heard the company is moving to the new building in March.
Yes, and our department gets the whole fifth floor. It'll have a lot more natural light.
That's great, but the commute will be longer for me. The new place isn't near a subway station.
Actually, management is planning a free shuttle bus from Central Station.
Really? That would make a big difference.

p3b.zh: 公司三月要搬到新大樓；女子擔心通勤變遠、附近沒地鐵；男子說公司打算從中央車站開免費接駁車。

qs.q: What are the speakers discussing?
What is the woman concerned about?
What does the man say management will provide?

script.t: Hi, this is Daniel from Bright Print. I'm calling about your order of five hundred brochures.
Oh, is there a problem?
The paper you chose is out of stock until next week. We can use a similar glossy paper and still deliver on Wednesday.
How similar is it? The brochures are for an important trade show.
It's almost identical, just slightly thinner. I can send a sample to your office this afternoon.
Please do. I'll decide after I see it.

p3b.zh: 印刷廠來電說客人選的紙缺貨，可改用類似的亮面紙仍在週三交貨；女子要先看樣品再決定。

qs.q: Why is the man calling?
What are the brochures for?
What will the man send?

script.t: Excuse me, does this bus go to the art museum?
No, this is the number 12. You need the 7. It stops right in front of the museum.
Where can I catch it?
Across the street, by the bakery. It comes every fifteen minutes.
Thanks. Do I need exact change?
You can just tap a credit card when you get on.

p3b.zh: 女子問這班公車到不到美術館；男子說要搭 7 號，在對面麵包店旁搭，每 15 分鐘一班，上車刷信用卡即可。

qs.q: Where does the woman want to go?
How often does the bus come?
How can the woman pay the fare?

script.t: Linda, the new intern starts tomorrow. Have you set up her computer?
Not yet. IT says her laptop won't arrive until Thursday.
Hmm. She can use the spare desktop in the training room for a few days.
Good idea. I'll ask IT to create her login today.
Thanks. And please give her a copy of the orientation schedule.

p3b.zh: 新實習生明天報到但筆電週四才到；男子建議先用訓練室的備用桌機；女子會請 IT 今天建帳號。

qs.q: Who is starting work tomorrow?
What problem does the woman mention?
What will the woman do today?
o: Ask IT to create a login
qs.why: ask IT to create her login today。

script.t: Good morning, Fresh Bites Catering. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to order lunch for a staff training on Friday. About thirty people.
Sure. Would you prefer sandwiches or hot meals?
Sandwiches, please, and a few vegetarian options.
No problem. We'll deliver at eleven forty-five. Can I have the address?
It's 210 Pine Street, third floor.

p3c.zh: 男子為週五的員工訓練訂約 30 人的午餐，選三明治並要素食選項；外燴 11:45 送達。

qs.q: What is the man ordering food for?
What does the man request?
What time will the food be delivered?

script.t: Have you seen the customer survey results?
Yes. Most people like our products, but many said the website is hard to use.
That's what I noticed too. Especially the checkout page.
Maybe we should hire a web designer to simplify it.
I agree. I'll bring it up at the budget meeting on Monday.

p3c.zh: 問卷顯示客人喜歡產品但網站難用（尤其結帳頁）；兩人想請網頁設計師簡化，男子會在週一預算會議提出。

qs.q: What did many customers complain about?
qs.why: the website is hard to use。

qs.q: What does the woman suggest?
What will the man do on Monday?
o: Raise the issue at a meeting
qs.why: bring it up at the budget meeting。

script.t: Hi, I'd like two tickets for the seven o'clock showing of Ocean Light.
Sorry, that showing is sold out. There's another one at nine fifteen.
That's a bit late. Is it playing tomorrow?
Yes, at five and seven thirty. You can also book online to choose your seats.
I'll take two for five o'clock tomorrow, then.

p3c.zh: 女子想買七點的電影票但已售完；明天有五點和七點半；她買明天五點兩張。

qs.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
What problem does the man mention?
When will the woman watch the film?

script.t: Karen, the photocopier keeps jamming. Should we call the repair company again?
It's the third time this month. Maybe it's time to replace it.
New ones are expensive, though.
We could lease one instead. The monthly fee includes maintenance.
That sounds reasonable. Can you get a few quotes?
Sure, I'll contact some suppliers this week.

p3c.zh: 影印機這個月卡紙第三次；女子建議改用租賃（月費含保養）；男子請她拿幾份報價。

qs.q: What is the problem?
What does the woman suggest?
What will the woman do this week?

script.t: Welcome to Greenleaf Pharmacy. Are you picking up a prescription?
Yes, for Robert Chen. My doctor said she sent it this morning.
Let me look. Yes, it's here, but it'll take about twenty minutes to prepare.
That's fine. I'll go to the coffee shop next door and come back.
Sounds good. We'll have it ready at the counter.

p3c.zh: 男子到藥局領處方藥；需約 20 分鐘準備；他先去隔壁咖啡店再回來。

qs.q: Where does the woman work?
How long will the man have to wait?
What will the man most likely do next?
qs.why: go to the coffee shop next door。

p4a.talk: Attention, shoppers. Thank you for visiting Maple Department Store. Today only, all winter coats on the third floor are thirty percent off. In addition, customers who spend more than one hundred dollars will receive a free scarf at the checkout. Please note that the store will close one hour early tonight, at eight o'clock, for inventory. We appreciate your understanding and wish you a pleasant day of shopping.
p4a.zh: 百貨公司廣播：今天三樓冬季外套七折；消費滿 100 美元送圍巾；今晚因盤點提早一小時（八點）打烊。

qs.q: What is on sale today?
qs.why: winter coats are thirty percent off。

qs.q: How can customers get a free gift?
qs.why: spend more than one hundred dollars。

qs.q: Why will the store close early?

p4a.talk: Hello, this message is for Ms. Rivera. This is Kevin from Summit Auto Repair. We've finished inspecting your car. The brakes are fine, but the front tires are quite worn and should be replaced soon. We have them in stock and could do it today for two hundred and forty dollars. If you'd like us to go ahead, please call me back before three o'clock so the car can be ready by the end of the day. Our number is 555-0182. Thanks.
p4a.zh: 修車廠留言：煞車沒問題，前輪胎磨損需更換，今天可換、240 美元；若要換請三點前回電。

qs.q: Who is the speaker?
What does the speaker recommend?
Why should the listener call before three o'clock?
o: To have the car ready today
qs.why: so the car can be ready by the end of the day。

p4a.talk: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Chocolate Factory. My name is Emma, and I'll be your guide today. Our tour lasts about forty-five minutes. First, we'll see how cocoa beans are roasted, and then we'll visit the packaging room. For safety reasons, please don't touch any of the machines, and keep your hairnets on at all times. At the end of the tour, you'll each receive a free box of chocolates in our gift shop.
p4a.zh: 巧克力工廠導覽：約 45 分鐘，先看烘焙可可豆再看包裝區；不要碰機器、全程戴髮網；最後在禮品店拿免費巧克力。

qs.q: Where is the talk taking place?
What are listeners asked to do?
What will listeners receive at the end?

p4a.talk: Before we finish today's meeting, I have one more announcement. Starting next month, we're introducing a new expense reporting system. Instead of filling out paper forms, you'll submit receipts through a mobile app. This should make reimbursements much faster, usually within five business days. Gina from Accounting will hold two training sessions next week, one on Tuesday and one on Thursday. Please sign up for one of them by Friday.
p4a.zh: 會議宣布：下個月起改用手機 App 報帳，退款約五個工作天；會計部 Gina 下週二、四各有一場訓練，請週五前報名。

qs.q: What is the speaker mainly announcing?
What is one benefit of the change?
What should listeners do by Friday?
o: Sign up for a training session
qs.why: sign up for one of them by Friday。

p4a.talk: This is Jenny Lee with your morning traffic report. Drivers heading downtown on Highway 9 should expect delays of up to twenty minutes because of road work near Exit 14. The work is scheduled to continue until Friday. If possible, take Elm Avenue instead. Also, the city reminds residents that the Harbor Street parking garage reopens today after renovations, with three hundred new spaces. Stay tuned for the weather after this short break.
p4a.zh: 早晨路況：9 號公路 14 號出口附近施工，最多延誤 20 分鐘，施工到週五，建議改走 Elm 大道；港口街停車場整修後今天重新開放，新增 300 個車位。

qs.q: What is causing delays?
What does the speaker suggest?
What will listeners hear next?

p4b.talk: Good afternoon, passengers. This is an announcement for Flight 382 to Seoul. Due to a late-arriving aircraft, the departure time has been changed from 3:15 to 4:30. The gate has also changed from Gate 22 to Gate 31. Passengers can pick up a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars at the service desk near Gate 25. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
p4b.zh: 機場廣播：飛首爾 382 班機因飛機晚到改為 4:30 起飛，登機門改到 31 號；可在 25 號門附近服務台領 15 美元餐券。

qs.q: Why has the flight been delayed?
What is the new gate?
What can passengers receive?
qs.why: a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars。

p4b.talk: Are you tired of spending hours cleaning your home? Let Sparkle Home Services do it for you! Our trained staff use only eco-friendly products that are safe for children and pets. We offer weekly, biweekly, and one-time cleanings. Book your first cleaning through our website this month and get twenty percent off. Visit sparklehome.com today and enjoy a spotless home without lifting a finger.
p4b.zh: 清潔公司廣告：使用對小孩寵物安全的環保產品；有每週、雙週、單次服務；本月透過網站預約首次清潔打八折。

qs.q: What is being advertised?
What does the speaker say about the products?
How can customers get a discount?
qs.why: book through our website this month。

p4b.talk: In business news, local electronics maker Novatech announced yesterday that it will open a new factory in Westfield next spring. The plant is expected to create about four hundred jobs. Novatech's CEO said the company chose Westfield because of its skilled workforce and good highway access. The company will hold a job fair at the Westfield Community Center on May 3 for anyone interested in applying.
p4b.zh: 新聞：電子廠 Novatech 明年春天在 Westfield 開新廠，預計創造約 400 個工作；選址原因是技術勞工多、交通方便；5 月 3 日在社區中心辦徵才博覽會。

qs.q: What did Novatech announce?
According to the speaker, why was Westfield chosen?
What will happen on May 3?
o: A job fair will be held.
qs.why: hold a job fair on May 3。

p4b.talk: Hi, Mr. Grant, this is Olivia Brooks from Lakeside Realty. I'm calling about the apartment on Willow Road that you asked about. The owner has agreed to lower the rent to fourteen hundred dollars a month if you sign a two-year lease. The apartment is available from the first of next month. I can show it to you again on Saturday morning if you'd like another look. Please let me know what time works for you.
p4b.zh: 房仲留言：Willow 路公寓的屋主同意簽兩年約就降租到每月 1400 美元；下個月一號可入住；週六早上可以再帶看。

qs.q: Who is the speaker?
What has the owner agreed to do?
What does the speaker offer to do?
qs.why: show it to you again on Saturday。

p4b.talk: Thanks for coming, everyone. As you know, our customer service team received over three thousand calls last month, and wait times were sometimes more than ten minutes. To improve this, we'll be adding an online chat option to our website starting next week. Three team members will handle chats during business hours. I'd like volunteers who are comfortable typing quickly. If you're interested, please e-mail me by Wednesday.
p4b.zh: 會議：上個月客服電話超過三千通，有時等十分鐘以上；下週起網站加線上客服聊天，需三位同仁負責，請想做的人週三前寄信給她。

qs.q: What problem does the speaker mention?
qs.why: wait times were more than ten minutes。

qs.q: What will the company add?
What are interested listeners asked to do?

p5a.q: The sales team ------- its quarterly target two weeks early.
p5a.zh: 業務團隊提早兩週達成季目標。
p5a.why: 句子缺動詞，敘述已發生的事 → 過去式 reached。

p5a.q: Please read the instructions ------- before assembling the shelf.
p5a.zh: 組裝架子前請仔細閱讀說明。
p5a.why: 修飾動詞 read → 副詞。

p5a.q: The museum is open daily ------- 9 A.M. to 5 P.M.
p5a.zh: 博物館每天上午九點到下午五點開放。

p5a.q: All new employees must ------- an orientation session.
p5a.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加說明會。

p5a.q: The report ------- by the finance department last Friday.
p5a.zh: 報告上週五由財務部準備。
p5a.why: 報告被準備 → 被動；last Friday → 過去。

p5a.q: ------- the bad weather, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
p5a.zh: 儘管天氣不好，戶外音樂會照常舉行。

p5a.q: Ms. Hayes asked ------- assistant to reschedule the meeting.
p5a.zh: 海斯小姐請她的助理重新安排會議。

p5a.q: This model is ------- than the one we bought last year.
p5a.zh: 這款比我們去年買的更輕。

p5a.q: The hotel offers a ------- breakfast to all guests.
p5a.zh: 飯店提供所有房客免費早餐。

p5a.q: Thank you for ------- our online survey.
p5a.zh: 感謝您填寫我們的線上問卷。
p5a.why: 介系詞 for 後接 V-ing。

p5b.q: The candidate ------- résumé impressed the committee will be invited for an interview.
p5b.zh: 履歷讓委員會印象深刻的那位應徵者會受邀面試。
p5b.why: candidate 的 résumé → 所有格 whose。

p5b.q: Customers can return items ------- 30 days of purchase.
p5b.zh: 顧客可在購買後 30 天內退貨。

p5b.q: The company has ------- expanded its operations in Asia.
p5b.zh: 公司成功擴展了亞洲業務。
p5b.why: 修飾動詞 expanded → 副詞。

p5b.q: Mr. Ortiz ------- in the marketing department since 2018.
p5b.zh: 奧提茲先生從 2018 年起就在行銷部工作。

p5b.q: The new policy will be explained to staff ------- the next meeting.
p5b.zh: 新政策會在下次會議上向員工說明。

p5b.q: Please submit your application ------- the end of the month.
The conference was so ------- that many attendees asked for a second session.
p5b.zh: 研討會很有趣，許多與會者要求再開一場。

p5b.q: Neither the manager ------- the assistant was available to answer questions.
p5b.zh: 經理和助理都沒空回答問題。

p5b.q: Our shipping costs are the ------- in the region.
p5b.zh: 我們的運費是本區最低的。
p5b.why: the ___ in the region → 最高級。

p5b.q: The documents must be ------- by both parties before Friday.
p5b.zh: 文件必須在週五前由雙方簽署。

p5c.q: The training session has been ------- until further notice.
p5c.zh: 訓練課程已延期，另行通知。

p5c.q: Employees ------- wish to work from home must get approval.
p5c.zh: 想在家工作的員工必須取得核准。

p5c.q: The store manager handled the complaint ------- himself.
p5c.zh: 店長親自處理了這個客訴。

p5c.q: We are looking forward to ------- with your company.
p5c.zh: 我們期待與貴公司合作。
p5c.why: look forward to＋V-ing（to 是介系詞）。

p5c.q: The airline ------- passengers about the gate change by text message.
p5c.zh: 航空公司用簡訊通知乘客登機門變更。
p5c.why: 航空公司主動通知，後面有受詞 → 主動。

p5c.q: Sales increased ------- after the new advertising campaign.
p5c.zh: 新廣告活動之後銷售額大幅成長。
p5c.why: 修飾動詞 increased → 副詞。

p5c.q: The restaurant is popular ------- its prices are quite high.
p5c.zh: 雖然價格頗高，這家餐廳還是很受歡迎。
p5c.why: 後面是句子、轉折 → even though。

p5c.q: Ms. Kim will ------- the team while the director is on vacation.
p5c.zh: 總監休假時由金小姐帶領團隊。

p5c.q: Our customer service representatives are available ------- the clock.
p5c.zh: 我們的客服人員全天候服務。

p5c.q: This laptop is not as expensive ------- the one in the window.
p5c.zh: 這台筆電沒有櫥窗那台貴。

p6a.title: E-mail: Order Update
p6a.text:
Dear Mr. Patel,
Thank you for your recent order from Office Plus. We are writing to let you know that the ergonomic chairs you ordered are [1] out of stock. We expect a new shipment to arrive on March 10. [2]. If you would prefer not to wait, we can offer you a similar model at the same price. [3], you may cancel the order for a full refund. Please reply to this e-mail to let us know which option you [4].
Sincerely,
Customer Service Team
p6a.zh: 辦公用品店通知 Patel 先生訂購的人體工學椅暫時缺貨，預計 3/10 到貨，屆時立即出貨；不想等可換同價類似款，或取消全額退款，請回信告知選擇。

qs.why: 修飾形容詞 out of stock → 副詞。

o: Your chairs will be shipped as soon as they arrive.
The chairs come in three colors.
qs.why: 接在「預計 3/10 到貨」後面，最自然的是「一到就出貨」。
提供另一個選項 → Alternatively（或者）。
which option you ___：子句缺現在式動詞。

p6a.title: Notice to All Tenants
p6a.text:
Please be advised that the main elevator in Building A will be [1] from Monday, June 3, to Wednesday, June 5. During this time, tenants are asked to use the service elevator located at the back of the building. [2]. We understand this may cause some inconvenience, especially for those [3] heavy items. Building staff will be available to assist with deliveries. Thank you for your [4].
Building Management
p6a.zh: 大樓公告：A 棟主電梯 6/3–6/5 維修，請改用後方貨梯；貨梯一次最多四人；搬重物的人可能不便，管理員會協助送貨。

o: The building was renovated last year.
Rent is due on the first of the month.
The service elevator can carry up to four people at a time.
Parking is available on the street.
qs.why: 緊接在「改用貨梯」之後，補充貨梯資訊最連貫。
those (who are) moving → 現在分詞修飾。

p6b.title: Article: Local Café Wins Award
p6b.text: Bean Corner, a small café on Elm Street, has won this year's Best Local Business award. The café was [1] five years ago by two former teachers, Sarah and Mike Dalton. Customers say they love the friendly atmosphere and the homemade pastries. [2]. The Daltons plan to use the prize money to [3] their kitchen. "We are truly grateful," said Sarah. "This award belongs to our customers, [4] supported us from the very beginning."
p6b.zh: Elm 街小咖啡店 Bean Corner 獲年度最佳在地商家；五年前由兩位前教師創立；顧客喜歡氣氛和手作糕點；週末常大排長龍；獎金將用來擴建廚房。

o: On weekends, the line often reaches the end of the block.
Teachers are needed in many schools.
Elm Street was repaved last spring.
qs.why: 前句講顧客喜愛，接「週末大排長龍」最連貫。

p6b.title: Memo: Holiday Schedule
p6b.text:
To: All Staff
From: Human Resources
The office will be closed on Monday, May 27, for the national holiday. All employees are expected to [1] to work on Tuesday, May 28. Please make sure that any urgent tasks are completed [2] Friday. If you are scheduled to be on call during the holiday, you should have [3] received a separate e-mail with details. [4]. Thank you, and enjoy the long weekend!
p6b.zh: 人資備忘：5/27 國定假日公司休息，5/28 回來上班；緊急工作請在週五前完成；假日值班者應已收到另一封信；若沒收到請聯絡主管。

qs.why: should have already received＝應該已經收到。

o: If you have not, please contact your supervisor.
The holiday was first celebrated in 1950.
Our new office opens in June.
Please wear formal clothes on Monday.
qs.why: 接續「應該已經收到信」→「如果沒有請聯絡主管」。

docs.text:
★★★★☆ Great food, slow service — by Jun T.
I had dinner at Olive Garden Bistro last Friday with three coworkers. The pasta was excellent, and the portions were generous. However, it took almost 40 minutes for our main dishes to arrive, even though the restaurant wasn't very busy. Our server apologized and gave us free dessert, which was a nice touch. I'd go back, but probably not when I'm in a hurry.

docs.title: Article
docs.text:
Riverside Opens New Community Garden
RIVERSIDE — More than a hundred residents attended the opening of the Riverside Community Garden on Saturday. The garden, built on a former parking lot near City Hall, has 60 individual plots that residents can rent for $25 a year.
"We wanted to turn an empty space into something that brings people together," said Mayor Linda Ford. All of the plots were reserved within the first week, and a waiting list has been created.
The garden also includes a children's area and a tool shed. Volunteers will offer free gardening classes on the first Sunday of every month. Those interested in joining the waiting list can sign up on the city's website.

p7c.zh: 市府旁的舊停車場改建為社區菜園，60 塊地每年租 25 美元，第一週就租滿並建候補名單；有兒童區、工具間，每月第一個週日有免費園藝課。

What was the site previously used for?
qs.why: built on a former parking lot。

qs.q: What is indicated about the plots?

qs.why: sign up on the city's website。
